propositions: When completion verifier fails with insufficiency due to search exhaustion, the gate should auto-resume the entire verification with the same arguments rather than surface the failure to the operator.

Auto-resumption qualifies only when all unmet criteria carry the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker; any unmet criterion without this marker (indicating refutation) disqualifies the attempt from resumption.

Resumption attempts are bounded by verify.auto_resume_max (default 2, configurable to 0 to disable) and progress condition: a resumption dispatches only when the prior attempt strictly increased the cache-credited PASS count.

Per-attempt resumption trail (attempt number, cache-credited count, remaining unmet count) is recorded to the verdict sidecar and close output; if bounded resumptions are exhausted, the failure surface includes the total resumption count attempted.
